name: render_posh_figures
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,base64
r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f','7','-l','7','-scale-to','1300','-singlefile','-png','sources/357571.pdf'],capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
s=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode();z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'figures/posh-page7.png','--base64'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
print('IMAGE:'+s)
